race.comment: AYAKA (10) is the one to beat after a much better fifth at Ipswich, where she was beaten just under two lengths after beginning awkwardly and not being fully tested late. She now comes back from provincial company, draws well and gets blinkers on for the first time. Expected to go close. TIME HAS COME (5) placed at this track first-up, beaten just over three lengths after being bumped at the start, and should strip fitter second-up over the longer trip. Gets map favours and can feature. SEA TURTLE (1) made ground here last start and backs up quickly, but the long maiden record and 1310m query keep him a place chance. TSUKAHARA (12) debut sixth was only fair and she now rises to 1310m. Watch for any market confidence.
